report_name: Georgia Power Data Breach Exposes Information of 300,000 Customers

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Threat Actor
threat_actors.description: An unidentified third party that conducted a data breach against Georgia Power's customer portal, exfiltrating the PII of approximately 300,000 customers.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: An unauthorized third party gained access to the Georgia Power online customer portal, bypassing its security controls to access customer data.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Collection
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor collected personally identifiable information (PII) from approximately 300,000 customer accounts after gaining access to the online portal.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor exfiltrated customer PII, including names, addresses, and the last four digits of SSNs, from the compromised web portal.

identities.name: Georgia Power
identities.description: A major U.S. utility provider that suffered a data breach affecting the PII of approximately 300,000 customers via its online portal.

identities.name: Southern Company
identities.description: The parent company of Georgia Power, which was also impacted by the cyberattack, with a total of 400,000 accounts affected across its subsidiaries.

indicators.name: Potential SQL Injection Attempt in Web Request
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential SQL Injection Attempt in Web Request
id: 2b8c9f0a-1d2e-4f3c-8a7b-9d0e1f2a3b4c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious keywords in a URI query string, which could be an indicator of a SQL injection attempt against a web application.
references:
  - https://roughdraftatlanta.com/2026/10/05/georgia-power-cyberattack-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - 'union '
      - 'select '
      - 'insert '
      - 'update '
      - 'delete '
      - 'drop '
      - ' or 1=1'
      - 'information_schema'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing common SQL keywords, which may indicate an attempt to exploit a public-facing application via SQL injection, as suggested in the article's detection guidance.

indicators.name: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Attempt in Web Request
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Attempt in Web Request
id: 5e6f7a8b-9c0d-4e1f-8a3b-4c5d6e7f8a9b
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious keywords in a URI query string, which could be an indicator of a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attempt against a web application.
references:
  - https://roughdraftatlanta.com/2026/10/05/georgia-power-cyberattack-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-06
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '<script>'
      - 'alert('
      - 'onerror='
      - 'onload='
      - 'javascript:'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing common XSS payloads, which may indicate an attempt to exploit a public-facing application, as suggested in the article's detection guidance.
